newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says economy good, needs balanced budget.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says economy good, needs balanced budget.

text.p: President Clinton on Friday said the U.S. economy was doing well but that it would benefit further from achieving a balanced budget agreement.

"Our economy is on the right track but to stay on that right track, we have to balance the budget while we go forward with the work that leads to continued growth and low inflation," he told a news conference.

He said he was hopeful "and I want to say again that the talks we have been continually having with congressional leaders of both parties will produce a balanced budget agreement this year and in the not too distance future."
He echoed a statement released earlier in the day that hailed a reduction in the unemployment rate and exceptionally strong job creation.
